quote: A macOS Primary dashboard using an accepted device grant without shared credentials can lose its page on a route, TLS, or URL refresh and show the reconnecting failure page.
note: The P1 finding warns that DashboardManager replaces a valid native-auth dashboard on reconnect, but its condition is the route guards rejecting a tokenless binding. The bug instead comes from the Equatable auth comparison failing when socket-owned legacy credentials retire first. Related rather than exact, chosen as the lower level because the code path differs.
